description: This file contains functions for audio processing in telephony applications, including resampling PCM audio to 8kHz, converting PCM to mu-law encoding, and chunking audio buffers for streaming.

methods.name: clamp16
methods.description: Clamps a number to the 16-bit signed integer range.

methods.name: sinc
methods.description: Calculates the sinc function, sin(pi * x) / (pi * x).

methods.name: sampleBandlimited
methods.description: Builds a low-pass filter kernel for resampling.

methods.name: resamplePcmTo8k
methods.description: Resamples 16-bit PCM audio to 8kHz using a windowed low-pass filter.

methods.name: pcmToMulaw
methods.description: Converts 16-bit PCM buffer to mu-law encoded buffer.

methods.name: convertPcmToMulaw8k
methods.description: Resamples PCM to 8kHz and converts to mu-law.

methods.name: chunkAudio
methods.description: Splits audio buffer into 20ms frames for streaming.

methods.name: linearToMulaw
methods.description: Converts a linear PCM sample to mu-law encoding.
